title: Wanasquattan (Amityville)
summary: A western Babylon placename near Amityville connected with Massapequa proprietors and a 1696 Huntington grant.
history_content: The placename is connected with the Massapequa proprietors and a Thomas Powell purchase license. Specific dated grant context is handled as a Timeline Entry.
translation_content:
Recorded forms include Wanasquattan and Wanasquatta. The name is interpreted as point or top of the hills.

Why Place Names Matter

“Learning about traditional place names can reveal deeper cultural relationships and impart more meaningful experiences when visiting the park.”

— National Park Service, Restoration of Indigenous Place Names (2021), opening text
preservation_content: Wanasquattan preserves a hill-related name within the western Babylon and Massapequa land-title landscape.
whereintheworld_content: Blue/general approximate marker in the Amityville and North Amityville area. This is not an exact 1696 tract boundary.
